items.title: Ralph LaLama interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 23, 2010
items.q: Who was the other — Laura Nyro, Carole King, yeah, and Jimi Hendrix.

ctx.x: And I guess I just — would you appreciate it? If your mother had to clean up? I mean because I spent a lot of time in hotel rooms. And I’m not saying, I mean I party but I don’t break glass and I just think these guys — it’s disrespectful. And sometimes the

music sounds that way to me. Not everybody. I mean I love Jimi Hendrix, you know, I loved a lot of people when I was growing up especially, that had something to say. You know? And I’m not against that, not at all. I love James Taylor, I mean that’s not rock & roll, but you know. Who was the other — Laura Nyro, Carole King, yeah, and Jimi Hendrix. I loved Jimi Hendrix. But I didn’t like Cream that much. But I liked Jimi Hendrix you know what I mean?
You don’t have to like everybody I guess.
